label: 50% deposit + hosting
proposalDescription: Enter the total build price and monthly hosting price in dollars. The client pays 50% now and authorizes the remaining 50% at launch. Hosting starts 30 days after launch, then renews monthly.
launchDescription: Use only for a 50% deposit + hosting proposal. Confirm the website is live and authorization is on file. Publishing charges the remaining 50% and schedules hosting 30 days after launch.

label: 100% upfront + hosting
proposalDescription: Enter the total build price and monthly hosting price in dollars. The client pays the entire build price now. No build balance is due at launch. Hosting starts 30 days after launch, then renews monthly.
launchDescription: Use only for a 100% upfront + hosting proposal. Publishing records launch and schedules hosting 30 days later. There is no additional website build charge.

label: Hosting only
proposalDescription: Enter the monthly hosting price in dollars. The website build is free. The client saves a card and approves hosting, with nothing charged upfront. The first hosting payment is at launch, then monthly.
launchDescription: Use only for a Hosting only proposal after card setup. Publishing charges the first monthly hosting payment immediately and starts monthly renewals. The website build is free.

label: Website only — no hosting
proposalDescription: Enter the total build price in dollars. The client pays 50% now and authorizes the remaining 50% at launch. No hosting subscription is created.
launchDescription: Use only for a Website only — no hosting proposal. Publishing charges the remaining 50% build balance. No hosting subscription is created.
